end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere through questions and examples.
Matched some everyday objects with 3D shapes, including dice–cube and gas cylinder–cylinder.
Described a cylinder as having two flat circular faces and a curved surface.
Described a cube as having six faces and a matchbox as a cuboid.
Teach-back was not completed; Ishita requested photos or sketches for several examples.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes and matching them with familiar objects such as dice, a gas cylinder and a matchbox. Ishita explained the cylinder’s two flat circular faces and curved surface, and later identified the gas cylinder as a cylinder after first discussing a cake example. At home, use real objects or simple drawings and ask Ishita to name the shape, faces and curved surfaces.
